info.title: Tatku United - Digital Services Marketplace API
info.description: Complete RESTful API documentation for Tatku United: an on-demand digital & home services scheduling and fulfillment platform. Includes all domain resources: Users, Providers, Managers, Regions, Categories, Services, Orders, Bookings, Payments, Reviews, Unavailability, and Platform Settings.
